llm.summary: This skill is coherent for generating software copyright registration materials, but users should carefully review generated filing text before using it in an official submission.

dimensions.detail: The skill's scripts read a user-provided repository or directory and generate DOCX/Markdown registration materials, which fits the stated software copyright registration purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow discloses GitHub cloning, local source scanning, file generation, optional browser-assisted form filling, and explicitly requires user confirmation before online filling and forbids automatic submission.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No hidden installer, package mutation, persistence setup, or background worker behavior was found in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access for cloning and local file writes are purpose-aligned, but users should choose the repository and output directory deliberately because source code and personal registration details are involved.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts do not store credentials, create persistent services, retain browser sessions, or request elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the skill read the selected codebase and create registration files locally. Before any official filing, verify the generated functions, technical features, author, copyright-holder, and date fields yourself; do not submit boilerplate text that does not accurately describe the software.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Generating form-ready function and technical descriptions is part of the skill's purpose, but the fallback boilerplate can be generic when README content is thin; treat it as a draft requiring review.
[SQP-2] expected: Cloning repositories and writing DOCX/Markdown outputs are disclosed in the workflow and are necessary for the stated material-generation task.
